text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, Trainer, but there are still
some
places I wish to visit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
There's something I'm looking for.
Would you be
willing to help me find it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She must be looking for something that's

important to her. Hoping to lend her any

assistance she might need, I follow
Mejiro Bright
to...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My! That fish is so very pretty. I wonder
what it's
called?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why, its tail fin looks rather like a little
ruffle...
Teehee. I  wonder what it's like
to have a frilly fin
like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh! And those two puffer fish are
adorable. When
they puff up together,
they resemble a pair of
Renaissance-era
breeches. ♪ Come, Trainer, this
way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ruffles and Renaissance-era breeches? Is
she
searching for fashion inspiration? ...I
think I'd
better keep an eye on her for a
little longer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... This is quite bitter. Milk and
sugar
really are a must...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I thought that perhaps it might taste
sweet today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...But coffee remains a bitter beverage. I
can still
taste it on my tongue!

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sweet and delicious! And the latte
art is so
cute! Could this coffee be any
better?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ahhh... What an adorable drawing of a bear! And this tastes ever so sweet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. ♪ Trainer. You have the
makings of a
latte mustache.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ahhh... It's so peaceful here.

text_block_list.name: Cow
text_block_list.text: Moooo...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Are you taking it easy as well, Mrs.
Cow?
That makes two of us...

text_block_list.name: Cow
text_block_list.text: Moooo...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Moo moooo...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! What's that? I should take the
time to smell
the flowers? Well, you're a
kind one, Miss Cow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you try, too, Trainer? I do
believe we
could all be friends.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we return to the academy
with me
none the wiser as to what Mejiro
Bright was
looking for. Did the search
slip her mind entirely?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I was! ♪ And thanks to your assistance, I
found it.
Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I found all sorts of them with you,
Trainer.
choice_data_list: あれ、いつの間に見つけたんだ？
あれ、いつの間に見つけたの？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My treasures... ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The things I treasure most in this
world—Maki,
Lolita fashion, antiques,
memories made
day-to-day...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'd been keeping them all in the treasure
chest in
my heart, for my own viewing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
After spending time with you, however, I
came to
realize something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The treasures in that chest seem to shine
brighter
when I gaze at them with you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And... I began to wonder.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What would happen if there were more
treasures?
What if we gazed at that
treasure chest even
longer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And I thought it would probably be very

wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My! What a peculiar thing to say.
choice_data_list: 今日は上手く手伝えたかな……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
On my own, I'd never have discovered
the
treasure that was today. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
On my own, I'd never have discovered
the
treasure that was today. ♪
choice_data_list: 次はどんな“宝物”を探そうか？
これからも張り切って探そう！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, there are simply so many options.
choice_data_list: 次はどんな“宝物”を探そうか？
これからも張り切って探そう！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow, the day after that, next
week, next
year... Time is most definitely
on our side!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, how about this? Trainer, why don't you tell me about your treasures?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee! I can hardly wait to see how
they'll
shine. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh yes, and find treasure we shall.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But straining ourselves in the process
won't do.
Let's have a nice, leisurely
search.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
For ordinary occasions and ordinary
places.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Because those are treasures as well. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, and there are so many more out
there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That pretty shell I found lying on the
beach, the
wristband Ryan gave to me,
the picture book I
drew with Dober
when we were little...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh? Where has the time gone?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Tomorrow and the next day, too.
How
wonderful it is to have so many
things to look
forward to.
choice_data_list: 続きは明日のお楽しみだな
続きは明日のお楽しみだね

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well then, until our next opportunity.
This is so
exciting! ♪
